scope: This continuation from guardian creation through Kuwait-Panama publication; audit became due during the bounded publication work and is completed before handoff.

findings.observation: All4 outputs were wider than their fixed camera crop targets. Two extreme-close rolls19 and9 were not realized precisely. Pose2039/2040 also differs from exact plan.
findings.action: Keep the fixed rolls and accepted technically usable outputs. For future unsubmitted prompts, prioritize the exact frozen crop and contact wording; never redraw rolls or regenerate these completed scenes.

findings.observation: Add descriptions click did not open the panel on first activation; visible link Enter worked. Next image Enter advanced but introduced a newline into the new empty ALT field; this was overwritten before saving.
findings.action: Use the visible Add descriptions link with Enter if the first click does not open it; use Next image click and verify each new editor state. Never repeat Post based on delayed navigation.

findings.observation: Media groups acquire the actual ALT as their accessible name after descriptions are saved. A generic Media-group count therefore falsely failed.
findings.action: Validate four Remove media buttons, four ALT badges, and four exact ALT-named groups, plus screenshot and published photo1-4 mapping.

findings.observation: All exposed internal originals were captured with supported visible image downloadMedia and prearmed download events. No provider direct HTTP or hidden input used.
findings.action: Retain this supported download method and avoid full-repository LFS scans.

findings.observation: Each ready post succeeded with one Post Enter activation; URLs and exact ALT endpoint order were recorded immediately.
findings.action: Keep bounded2+2 reservations, preflight parity and one-shot intent locks.
